content:
The text is from a special newsletter called "Fighting Back" created by the opinion section of the Guardian newspaper. It will be available until the presidential inauguration and focuses on protecting civil rights and freedoms during Donald Trump's presidency. Readers are invited to subscribe if they haven't already. 

The newsletter suggests readers take time to relax and reflect by taking a walk, practicing meditation, or talking with loved ones. After reflecting, readers should write a personal statement that focuses on a social or political issue important to them. It encourages thinking about various ways to address this issue at different levels of society and government, such as local, state, or federal government, as well as within businesses and other social groups.
